(Mu) Predator.name: (Mu) Predator
(Mu) Predator.description: Take +1d to rolls against weakened or vulnerable targets. Whenever you gather information on a weakness or vulnerability, the worst you can get is a 4/5 result.

(My) Psy-dancing.name: (My) Psy-dancing
(My) Psy-dancing.description: You may push yourself to cloud a target's mind and Sway them in the face of contradictory evidence. "You must do as I say. I am the ambassador." Spend 1 stress for each additional feature: they have only vague memories of the event OR it works on a small group.

(Mu) Backup.name: (Mu) Backup
(Mu) Backup.description: An ally's push costs 1 stress (not 2) on any action you set up or assist.

(P) Commander.name: (P) Commander
(P) Commander.description: Whenever you lead a group action, gain +1 scale (for example, a small group counts as a medium group). If you lead a group action in combat, you may count multiple 6s from different rolls as a critical.

(Mu) Battleborn.name: (Mu) Battleborn
(Mu) Battleborn.description: You may expend your special armor to reduce harm from an attack in combat or to push yourself during a fight.

(P) Traveler.name: (P) Traveler
(P) Traveler.description: You're comfortable around unusual cultures and xenos. You gain potency when attempting to Consort with or Sway them.

(My) Sundering.name: (My) Sundering
(My) Sundering.description: You may push yourself to Attune to the Way and twist it, causing psychic harm to anyone in the area vulnerable to your assault. You may spend 1 stress for each additional feature: it damages instead of stuns OR you and anyone you choose get +2d to resist the effects.

(Sc) Xeno.name: (Sc) Xeno
(Sc) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
Scoundrels are often audience-inserts, representing an "ordinary person." A xeno Scoundrel is an exercise in humanizing the Other and making the unusual characters of Procyon approachable. Think about your culture and people when making your xeno. Do your stodgy people accept your disregard for the rules? Are they welcomed in Hegemonic society or are they on the fringe of acceptability themselves? Are they from Procyon or elsewhere in the galaxy?

(My) Xeno.name: (My) Xeno
(My) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
The sector is rife with species that are uniquely attuned to the Way. Some claim ancestry to the Ur, while others claim evolution on a Way-ridden planet. Regardless, as a xeno Mystic, you're giving up a key starting ability and should consider how it influences your development as a Mystic. Work with your GM and table to define special abilities and permissions for the specific mystic tradition of your people.

(Mu) Unstoppable.name: (Mu) Unstoppable
(Mu) Unstoppable.description:
You can push yourself to do one of the following: perform a feat of physical force that verges on the superhuman OR engage a small gang on equal footing in close combat.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(Sp) Subterfuge.name: (Sp) Subterfuge
(Sp) Subterfuge.description: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence of persuasion or suspicion. When you resist with insight, gain +1d.

(Mu) Wrecking Crew.name: (Mu) Wrecking Crew
(Mu) Wrecking Crew.description: Your strength and ferocity are infamous. When striking in melee, you gain +1d. Whenever you spend a gambit in combat, you also gain +1 effect on that action.

(Sp) Xeno.name: (Sp) Xeno
(Sp) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
Aside from diplomats, xeno Speakers are somewhat unusual in the Hegemony. Amongst the Syndicates, xenos are far more accepted and in some, even preferred. Space adventure has plenty of examples of natural empaths, species with advanced cognitive functions, or even protocol robots that serve as Speakers for their crew. When considering your xeno heritage, think about how your species communicates and work with your GM to figure out how those styles of communication might manifest in play.

(Sp) Player.name: (Sp) Player
(Sp) Player.description: You always know when someone is lying to you.

(My) The Way.name: (My) The Way
(My) The Way.description:
You can spend a gambit instead of paying any stress cost.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(Mu) Xeno.name: (Mu) Xeno
(Mu) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
From Worf to D'Argo to Chewbacca, aliens mighty in a fight have been a staple of the space opera genre. The Muscle's starting ability is significant, but many xenos have strength far beyond that of a normal human. Some may have more limbs, or adaptations for harsh environments. Consider how your xeno heritage might make you a more useful Muscle, and talk with your table about how you want to use your Xeno ability.

(St) Patch.name: (St) Patch
(St) Patch.description: You may doctor someone during a job to allow them to ignore the effects of a harm penalty.

(My) Kinetics.name: (My) Kinetics
(My) Kinetics.description: You can push yourself to do one of the following: use the Way to throw a table-sized object with dangerous force OR propel yourself briefly with superhuman speed.

(My) Psy-blade.name: (My) Psy-blade
(My) Psy-blade.description: You can focus Way energy into your melee weapon. While charged, the weapon can cut through non-shielded materials with ease, and you gain potency on your melee attacks.

(Me) Tinker.name: (Me) Tinker
(Me) Tinker.description:
When you work on a clock with Rig or Hack or when you Study a schematic, fill +1 segment.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(Me) Analyst.name: (Me) Analyst
(Me) Analyst.description: When you Hack a system, you may also ask a question about the owner or location of the system as though you had rolled a 6 on gather info. When you resist the consequences of Hacking, roll +1d.

(My) Center.name: (My) Center
(My) Center.description: You gain Meditation as a vice. When you indulge this vice, clear +1 stress and add Dark Visions as a possible overindulgence.

(Sp) Purpose.name: (Sp) Purpose
(Sp) Purpose.description: You may expend your special armor to push yourself when outclassed by your opposition or when under the effects of wounds. When you resist with Resolve , gain +1d.

(St) Dr. Strange.name: (St) Dr. Strange
(St) Dr. Strange.description: Your research and fields of study are fringe, esoteric, and focus on the mystical. You may always handle Precursor artifacts safely. When you Study an artifact or Doctor a strange substance, you may ask one: what could this do? OR why could this be dangerous?

(Sc) Shoot First.name: (Sc) Shoot First
(Sc) Shoot First.description: When you attack from hiding or spring a trap, take +1d. When there's a question about who acts first, the answer is you (two characters with Shoot First act simultaneously).

(St) Book Learning.name: (St) Book Learning
(St) Book Learning.description: You speak a multitude of languages and are broadly educated. Gain +1d when using Study during a downtime activity.

(P) Leaf On the Wind.name: (P) Leaf On the Wind
(P) Leaf On the Wind.description: When you push yourself, you may spend +1 stress (3 stress total) to gain both +1 effect and +1d instead of one or the other.

(Me) Junkyard Hunter.name: (Me) Junkyard Hunter
(Me) Junkyard Hunter.description: When you acquire parts or equipment during downtime, you may either gain two assets or one asset at +1 quality.

(Mu) Bodyguard.name: (Mu) Bodyguard
(Mu) Bodyguard.description: When you protect a crewmate, resist with +1d. When you take harm, clear 1 stress.

(Sp) Infiltrator.name: (Sp) Infiltrator
(Sp) Infiltrator.description: You are not affected by quality or Tier when you bypass security measures.

(Sc) Tenacious.name: (Sc) Tenacious
(Sc) Tenacious.description: Penalties from harm are one level less severe (though level 4 harm is still fatal).

(Sp) Favors Owed.name: (Sp) Favors Owed
(Sp) Favors Owed.description: During downtime, you get +1d when you acquire assets or lay low. Any time you gather info, take +1d.

(P) Keen Eye.name: (P) Keen Eye
(P) Keen Eye.description: You have sharp eyes and notice small details many might overlook. Gain +1d when firing ship guns or making trick shots.

(Sp) Air of Respectability.name: (Sp) Air of Respectability
(Sp) Air of Respectability.description:
You get an extra downtime activity to acquire assets or lay low.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(Sc) Daredevil.name: (Sc) Daredevil
(Sc) Daredevil.description: When you make a desperate roll, you may take +1d. If you do so, do not mark xp in that action's attribute.

(St) Moral Compass.name: (St) Moral Compass
(St) Moral Compass.description: When you do the right thing at cost to yourself, mark xp (any category).

(Me) Construct Whisperer.name: (Me) Construct Whisperer
(Me) Construct Whisperer.description: Machines speak to you when you Study them. The first time you roll a critical while fixing or building a particular machine, you may add a simple modification to it.

(Me) Hacker.name: (Me) Hacker
(Me) Hacker.description: You may expend your special armor to resist the consequences of Hacking or to push yourself when Hacking or gathering info electronically.

(Sp) Disarming.name: (Sp) Disarming
(Sp) Disarming.description: Whenever you use a gambit while speaking, hostilities and danger also pause while you speak.

(St) Welcome Anywhere.name: (St) Welcome Anywhere
(St) Welcome Anywhere.description: While wearing your medic garb, you are welcome even in dangerous places. Gain +1d to Consort or Sway when offering to tend to anyone in need.

(P) Exceed Specs.name: (P) Exceed Specs
(P) Exceed Specs.description: While onboard a ship, you may damage a ship system you have access to in order to gain +1d or +1 effect to a roll.

(St) Under Pressure.name: (St) Under Pressure
(St) Under Pressure.description: Add a gambit to the pool whenever you or a crew member suffers level 2 or greater harm.

(Sc) I Know a Guy.name: (Sc) I Know a Guy
(Sc) I Know a Guy.description: When you first dock at a port after being away, pick one and ask the GM about a job: it's not deadly OR it pays well enough OR it's not a rush job OR it comes from a faction you trust OR it targets an enemy you have. You may spend 1 cred per additional feature.

(P) Punch It!.name: (P) Punch It!
(P) Punch It!.description: When you spend a gambit on a desperate roll, it counts as risky instead.

(Me) Fixed.name: (Me) Fixed
(Me) Fixed.description: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence from machines breaking or being damaged or to push yourself when repairing or building a machine.

(Sp) Old Friends.name: (Sp) Old Friends
(Sp) Old Friends.description: Whenever you land in a new location, write down a friend you know there (under Influential Friends on your playbook sheet).

(Mu) Flesh Wound.name: (Mu) Flesh Wound
(Mu) Flesh Wound.description: If you're wounded at the beginning of downtime, mark +3 segments on your healing clock. When you push yourself to ignore wound penalties, it takes only 1 stress (not 2).

(Me) Overclock.name: (Me) Overclock
(Me) Overclock.description: When you spend a gambit on a Rig roll to repair or upgrade, treat the system you worked on as 1 quality higher for the remainder of the job.

(P) Xeno.name: (P) Xeno
(P) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
Xeno Pilots are usually associated with xeno ships. If you pursue the option, ask your GM about modifications that you might be able to make to your ship, or unusual upgrades your people might have access to. When developing your people, think of ways their piloting might be affected by having uncommon senses (perhaps they can see gravity or other spectrums), or unique ways of interfacing (such as direct neural connections).

(Me) Xeno.name: (Me) Xeno
(Me) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
Every species has Mechanics, so when playing a xeno, consider how that xenotype relates to machines. Some xenos have an unusual relationship with technology (particularly Ur-based technology), such as the Sah'iir, while others use unusual materials, like the Mem.

(Me) Mechanic's Heart.name: (Me) Mechanic's Heart
(Me) Mechanic's Heart.description: When you speak from your heart, your words can reach even the most hardened criminal and you gain potency.

(St) I'm a Doctor Not a....name: (St) I'm a Doctor Not a...
(St) I'm a Doctor Not a....description:
You can push yourself to roll your Doctor rating while performing a different action. Say which patient, research, or posting taught you this trick.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(Me) Bailing Wire and Mech Tape.name: (Me) Bailing Wire and Mech Tape
(Me) Bailing Wire and Mech Tape.description: You get an extra downtime activity to repair and the repair activity costs you 0 cred.

(My) Warded.name: (My) Warded
(My) Warded.description: You may expend your special armor to resist the consequences of a Way attack or artifact use or push yourself when using mystic powers.

(P) Hedonist.name: (P) Hedonist
(P) Hedonist.description: When you indulge your vice, you may adjust the dice outcome by +/-2. An ally who joins you may do the same.

(My) Way Shield.name: (My) Way Shield
(My) Way Shield.description: You can block blaster bolts with the Way (resist with Resolve ). If you resist a blaster attack, you may spend 1 stress to redirect fire and make an attack of your own with it.

(St) Combat Medic.name: (St) Combat Medic
(St) Combat Medic.description: You may expend your special armor to resist any consequence while tending to a patient. When you doctor someone in combat, clear 1 stress.

(Sc) Never Tell Me the Odds.name: (Sc) Never Tell Me the Odds
(Sc) Never Tell Me the Odds.description: You generate gambits on desperate rolls. You may also generate gambits even if you spent a gambit.

(Sc) Serendipitous.name: (Sc) Serendipitous
(Sc) Serendipitous.description:
Your crew starts with +1 gambit when the pool resets.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(My) Visions.name: (My) Visions
(My) Visions.description: Spend 1 stress to remotely view a distant place or person tied to you in some intimate way. Spend 1 stress for each extra feature: it lasts for a minute rather than a moment OR your target can also see and hear you OR you may see something only familiar to you, not intimate.

(Sp) Heart To Heart.name: (Sp) Heart To Heart
(Sp) Heart To Heart.description: When you provide meaningful insight or heartfelt advice that a crewmate follows, you both clear 1 stress.

(St) Physicker.name: (St) Physicker
(St) Physicker.description: You may study a malady, wounds, or corpse and gather info from a crime scene. Also, your crew gets +1d to recovery rolls.

(Mu) Ready For Anything.name: (Mu) Ready For Anything
(Mu) Ready For Anything.description: When being ambushed, you gain potency to all actions during a flashback and your first flashback costs 0 stress.

(P) Ace Pilot.name: (P) Ace Pilot
(P) Ace Pilot.description:
You have potency on all speed-related rolls. When you roll to resist the consequences of piloting, gain +1d.

Not eligible for selection as a Veteran advance.

(P) Side Job.name: (P) Side Job
(P) Side Job.description: You may spend a downtime activity in port doing odd jobs. Gain 1 cred. If there are rumors floating about, the GM will tell you of them.

(Mu) Scary.name: (Mu) Scary
(Mu) Scary.description: You have an air of menace and danger obvious to even the most unobservant. You gain potency when trying to intimidate someone. If done immediately after a show of force, also take +1d.

(Sc) When the Chips Are Down.name: (Sc) When the Chips Are Down
(Sc) When the Chips Are Down.description: You gain a second use of special armor between each downtime.

(Sc) Devil's Own Luck.name: (Sc) Devil's Own Luck
(Sc) Devil's Own Luck.description: You may expend your special armor to resist the consequences of blaster fire or to push yourself when talking your way out of (or running from) trouble.

(St) Xeno.name: (St) Xeno
(St) Xeno.description:
You may spend Stress (0-2) to perform an inhuman feat only members of your species can do. (See page 296)
There are numerous species with a knack for medical science and enhanced senses that render a medical scanner unnecessary. Think about how you might approach healing differently than a human doctor. Perhaps you're unused to species with a single heart. Or find it annoying that others can't just regenerate limbs like your people can. Embrace and celebrate the differences. Regardless of the species, most physicians are at least superficially well treated in Procyon; you're less likely to have problems than other xenos.

(Sc) Ask Questions Later.name: (Sc) Ask Questions Later
(Sc) Ask Questions Later.description: When you Consort to gather info, you gain +1 effect and can, in addition, ask: Who might this benefit?
